text:
Customer (jonathan@acme.com): Hi — I just signed up, verified my email, added a card and completed 3DS, but I don't see the free trial credits in the dashboard. Account id acct_49382. Can someone check?

sarah_support: thanks, opening thread in #support. i'll pull the account events and payment logs. can you confirm the country you set on the account?

Customer (jonathan@acme.com): Account country is Ireland (IE). Card BIN is a US-issued card (ends with ...4242).

sarah_support: ok pulling logs for acct_49382 now. one sec.

sarah_support: admin events show: `{"event":"trial_credit_evaluation","result":"blocked","reason":"bin_country_mismatch","note":"card_bin=US account_region=IE"}`

mike_payments: i can take this — looks like our auto-grant rule blocks trial credits when BIN country != account region to reduce cross-border fraud. 3DS succeeded but that rule still blocks automatic trial grant.

sarah_support: is 3DS pass not considered enough to bypass the BIN check? customer completed verification so this feels like a false positive.

mike_payments: 3DS lowers risk but our signal chain currently treats BIN mismatch as a hard gate for auto-grants. we do a secondary risk_score check, but here risk_score was borderline and a manual review was never triggered.

mike_payments: I can manually grant the trial credits now. steps i will run: `POST /internal/grants {"account_id":"acct_49382","grant_type":"trial","amount":25,"reason":"manual_support_grant"}` then attach grant id to account notes.

sarah_support: please do. let me know grant id so I can notify customer.

mike_payments: done — grant id g_9876 created and applied. Customer balance +25 trial credits. I also added note: "manual grant for BIN mismatch following 3DS success; please review gating policy".

sarah_support: sending customer the confirmation now.

sarah_support -> Customer (jonathan@acme.com): Hi Jonathan — we've manually applied your free trial credits (25). Sorry for the friction, you should see them in the dashboard now. Reach out if anything else. :white_check_mark:

Customer (jonathan@acme.com): I see them now, thanks!

anya_ops: filing follow-up ticket to review BIN mismatch gating rule — high FP for EU accounts using US cards. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-2145 (P2). tagging payments + trust.

payments-bot: PaymentIntent pi_1HkXy2... status: succeeded, 3DS: authenticated, risk_level: low (stripe).

mike_payments: proposal: change auto-grant logic to treat `3DS authenticated + stripe.risk_level in [low, moderate]` as override for BIN mismatch for trial grants. will draft RFC.

sarah_support: thanks all — closing thread after follow-up ticket. :v:
